complete_examples.text: To overcome the shortcoming of traditional finite element computing model, the efficient displacement-based fiber beam-column element and masonry infill macro-element are used to establish the deterministic numerical model of frame structures.
Under the small deformation stage, the masonry infill panels, even when damaged, also can provided anti-collapse resistance and contribute to overall structural response.
